design_source_of_truth.location: frontend/src, frontend/src/index.css and frontend/public logo assets

primary_users: professionals who need a private local meeting record
users reviewing and analyzing their own recorded meetings
primary_jobs: start and understand a reliable meeting recording
transcribe a recording and understand processing state
recover from permission, audio, model or processing failures without losing work

golden_path.normal_path_rule: A configured user can complete the golden path without understanding backend, helper, process, port, model-path or routing concepts.

surface_hierarchy.home: understand what happened, what needs attention and what to open or do next
surface_hierarchy.new_meeting: confirm meeting context and start recording
surface_hierarchy.record: understand capture status and safely stop
surface_hierarchy.transcribe: start transcription, understand progress and recover from failure
surface_hierarchy.analyze: choose the trust/runtime boundary in user language and run analysis with strong defaults
surface_hierarchy.review: review transcript, speakers, actions, decisions, risks and derived insights

complexity_disclosure.essential: Information and actions required to complete the user's current task.
complexity_disclosure.contextual: Optional task-relevant choices such as project, capture source or enrichment that can change the outcome.
complexity_disclosure.advanced: Expert configuration such as model or quality overrides that normal use does not require.
complexity_disclosure.diagnostics: Internal runtime, helper, process, port, log, routing and model-path details used for troubleshooting rather than normal operation.
complexity_disclosure.recovery_exception: A technical condition may surface outside diagnostics only when the user must act on it; present the user-facing consequence and recovery action before raw technical detail.

accessibility.target: macOS accessibility conventions plus WCAG 2.2 AA semantics for web-rendered content where applicable

critical_journeys.name: Start, monitor and safely stop a local meeting recording
Transcribe a recording and recover from processing failure
Review transcript, speakers and derived meeting evidence
Run meeting analysis with an explicit provider/runtime choice

validation.accessibility_automation: frontend lint/typecheck plus component semantic review; dedicated accessibility runner not yet adopted
validation.visual_regression: N/A as an automated suite; bounded docs/assets views are references rather than pass/fail baselines
validation.manual_accessibility: REAL_ENVIRONMENT keyboard, focus, VoiceOver and reduced-motion checks for release-sensitive UI changes
validation.usability_evidence: targeted product review for high-risk workflow changes; no continuous usability study is currently declared
